summary: Independent end-to-end verification of the Smart Medication List + Refill (preview). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_smart_med_refill.py (11 tests, 11 passed). Verified: (1) GET /api/portal/medications returns {pharmacy_label:'1670 Dufferin Drug Mart', medications:[3 active]} for Maria with Metformin/Ramipril/Atorvastatin; same shape for delegate on Linda returning Levothyroxine+Amlodipine; unauthorized bogus patient_id returns 404 (no existence leak). (2) POST /api/portal/refill-requests single-standard (months=2) returns batch_id+1 request with source=patient_refill, destination_pharmacy_label='1670 Dufferin Drug Mart', internal_status=received, patient_note persisted. (3) Multi-med submission (3 ids) creates 3 prescription_requests sharing one batch_id and all appear scoped in admin GET /api/internal/prescriptions. (4) Longer supply (6 months) stays internal_status=received (NEVER auto-approved) and travel_note persists; Other free-text supply_text also stays received. (5) Empty medication_ids -> 400. (6) Delegate refill on-behalf-of Linda (?on_behalf_of=linda_pid) creates request with patient_name 'Nguyen, Linda'. (7) Photo path (POST /api/portal/prescriptions/photo multipart) creates source=patient_photo, review_required=true, attachment stored; GET /api/portal/medications count UNCHANGED (3) after photo submission, confirming no mutation to the official patient_medications list. (8) Admin kevinrodriguez9528 sees the photo request in /api/internal/prescriptions and GET /api/internal/prescriptions/{id}/attachment returns 200. (9) Existing physician/pharmacy Rx queue regression: /api/internal/prescriptions still returns items unchanged. UI (Playwright, Maria login via /signin -> /portal/prescriptions): your-medicines-card renders with exactly 3 medicine-card entries (Metformin/Ramipril/Atorvastatin), NO edit/add/delete controls present on them; each has a medicine-refill-<id> button that opens refill-details. Supply options supply-1/2/3/longer render; selecting 'longer' reveals supply-4/5/6/other + travel-note. Destination reads '1670 Dufferin Drug Mart' with NO pharmacy picker/select element in DOM. refill-note works, refill-submit submits (confirmation visible in 'Your prescription requests' grouped history with Received badge). med-not-listed opens photo-review panel with photo-take, photo-upload, photo-med-name, photo-note, photo-submit all present. All data-testids from the spec present and correct.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /portal/refill-requests correctly copies authoritative fields (drug, strength, directions) from patient_medications — never from patient free text. Good invariant.
Photo path NEVER touches patient_medications (verified empirically — count before/after unchanged). Source=patient_photo + review_required=true is the right boundary.
Longer-supply branch stays internal_status='received' even when months in (4,5,6) or free-text — consistent with 'never auto-approved' requirement.

server.py now ~6885 lines (previous iter: ~6692). The Rx/portal section has grown — consider extracting /portal/refill-requests + /portal/prescriptions/photo + helpers into a dedicated patient_refill router/module. Not a blocker.

LOW: `requested_months` branch in longer-supply allows `months` to pass through as any positive int if not in (4,5,6). This is intentional per the 'Other months' spec, but worth adding a sane upper bound (e.g. <=24) to prevent nonsense values like 999 reaching the physician queue.

LOW: destination_pharmacy_label is resolved at refill-request create-time via _refill_pharmacy_label(). If the practice.default_pharmacy_name changes between create and physician review, the request still shows the historical label — correct behavior for audit, worth confirming with product.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 14 spec data-testids present; refill + longer-supply + photo + fixed-pharmacy invariant all verified in-browser

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_smart_med_refill.py — run with env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set. Pytest in this repo defaults to xdist; this suite is small (11 tests) and runs fine with or without `-o addopts='-p no:xdist'`. Preview date is 2026-10-01. Admin GET /api/internal/prescriptions returns a bare list (not {items}). Photo attachment downloaded via GET /api/internal/prescriptions/{id}/attachment (follow redirects). Delegate on_behalf_of pattern works for both GET /portal/medications and POST /portal/refill-requests. UI data-testids all per spec; no selector drift.
rca of the issue: No product bugs found — feature behaves exactly to the preview spec.
